name: Extract Vitality
description: Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Fortitude against a creature within short range. On a win, it takes 1d4 damage and you regain that amount of Endurance. On a loss, it takes 1 damage and you regain 1 Endurance.
successes:
✨: Roll an additional d4.

🌞: Add HEART to each roll.

💀: Check a Condition.
